critical_code_review_comments: TILES/CANON_NAV in /app/frontend/src/pages/CanonOSShellPage.jsx is the hand-set source of truth for tile lit/partial/dormant state — the Jest cell 'All six modules render LIT' now guards against staleness going forward. Good structural fix.

Backend sort tuple [(is_sample, -1), (state, 1), (created_at_iso, -1)] in routers/team.py access_register endpoint keeps sample-marked rows at the top of every response regardless of collection growth — verified live: first revoked SAMPLE at index 15/60 out of 315 total rows. Defense-in-depth slice bump 30→60 is redundant given the sort, but harmless.

Frontend counts strip derives revoked/pending client-side from the fetched rows array while total/active come from the API — inconsistent source of truth. If total/active reflect the whole collection but the derived counts only reflect the visible window (315 fetched → matches here), then for very large collections the derived counts could understate. Consider adding revoked_count + pending_count to the API response for symmetry.
